editorial.blurb: A no-frills Hyderabadi gem in Chicago where aromatic biryanis, tender haleem, and bold spiced dishes arrive in generous portions at unbeatable prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Bring cash (there's an ATM on-site) and ask the staff to adjust spice levels when ordering—their Chicken Fry and Chicken 65 pack serious heat, but the kitchen listens.
